subject: Hospitality
title: The Restaurant of the Future
description: A 60-second lesson on The Restaurant of the Future.

hook.text: By 2030, some predict half of restaurant orders will be delivery-only. The dining room may become optional, not essential.

buildup.text: Ghost kitchens, virtual brands, and automated ordering are reshaping the industry. Physical space is being questioned.

discovery.text: Yet fine dining is booming. People crave experiences technology can't replicate—ambiance, human connection, surprise.

twist.text: The industry is splitting: ultra-efficient delivery for convenience and immersive dining for experience. The middle is vanishing.

climax.text: Restaurants that survive will either be incredibly efficient or incredibly special. Average is the danger zone.

punchline.text: Fast or unforgettable—pick one. The middle ground is disappearing.

quiz.question: What is happening to the 'middle' of the restaurant industry?
options: It's vanishing—restaurants must be ultra-efficient or incredibly experiential
